focus: The phase 009 core consolidation in lib/relaunch-core.cjs against its five adapter call sites
noveltyJustification: Three of four findings are new defects or unguarded duplicates in code phase 009 changed; the fourth (the Pi core type mirror) is a new drift surface the consolidation created.
answeredQuestions: Which decisions the phase 009 core consolidation moved into `lib/relaunch-core.cjs` still disagree with at least one adapter's call site, and what does each disagreement break?
ruledOut: Treating Claude's missing record.loopId guard as a defect: readRelaunchFile resolves the path from the same loopId
Treating resolveKillerTarget's refusal to arm without a process table as a defect: it fails closed before arming

label: HANDOFF_SECTIONS is declared twice: relaunch-core.cjs:22 freezes the list validateHandoff enforces, nudge.cjs:30 keeps a mutable copy and prints it as 'exactly this shape' at nudge.cjs:107, so adding a required section to the core alone makes every note written from the nudge fail validation. Fix: export HANDOFF_SECTIONS from the core, require it in nudge.cjs, and add a nudge test asserting every core section appears as a '## ' heading in handoffText().

arm() returns an already-armed record verbatim (relaunch-core.cjs:361) without rewriting armedAt, and all four arm paths reach that branch after a killer dies (claude/stop-arm.mjs:100, codex/stop-arm.mjs:107, hermes/session-end-arm.mjs:74, opencode/session-relaunch.js:284), so a re-arm keeps the first arm's timestamp, shouldRelaunch:445 returns stale, and skilled-loop:520 consumes the record and prints the manual command instead of relaunching. Fix: re-persist { ...record, armedAt: toIsoTimestamp(now), cwd } in the armed branch and update the assertion at tests/relaunch-core.test.cjs:488 that pins the old behaviour.

manualClaimCommand reads process.env directly (relaunch-core.cjs:596) instead of taking the env parameter every sibling helper takes, so the killer's timeout branch injects one environment into unarm (killer.cjs:499) and builds the notification command from another (killer.cjs:516), and the template path is only reachable by mutating process.env in tests (tests/relaunch-core.test.cjs:793). Fix: add env = process.env as a fourth parameter and pass the killer's environment through notifyManualClaim.

pi/session-relaunch.ts re-types four of the core's twenty-four exports in a local CoreModule (pi/session-relaunch.ts:25), a mirror no compiler check reaches because relaunch-core.cjs carries no types, so a renamed or re-signed export leaves the Pi suite green and breaks the runtime call at pi/session-relaunch.ts:277. Fix: assert in pi/session-relaunch.test.ts that each declared name exists as a function on the required core module.
